sleep.participant_filter: alive and not spectator; all must be in bed and all must reach deep sleep
sleep.daytime_rest: bed pose allowed without advancing the night

simulation.well_rested_requires: complete simulation, never interrupted, recipient alive and still in bed
simulation.effect_clear_requires: recipient alive and still in bed

sleep.network_authority: server counts, client renders snapshot only

respawn.clock: actual gameTime, independent of the editable dayTime
respawn.pause_when: there is at least one alive non-spectator player and all such players are deeply asleep
respawn.manual_respawn: native button remains available before the automatic deadline
respawn.automatic_action: native PlayerList.respawn, preserving clone/death-XP/inventory/bed validation events
respawn.reconnect: restore remaining seconds; do not restart at 120
respawn.network_authority: server counts, client displays own timer only

modern_adaptations: advance dayTime and explicitly simulate source food updates; do not jump the shared multi-dimension gameTime
do not bulk catch up modern entities, crops, furnaces or scheduled ticks through the legacy independent-clock mechanism
keep modern bed validation and death-screen controls
keep existing lunar and curse refusal rules
